On 21 November 2017 according to ''UzPFL'' management decision the [[Uzbek League]] was officially renamed to ''Uzbekistan Super League'' starting from 2018 season. The number of teams playing in top division of Uzbek football is reduced from 16 to 12.{{cite news |url= https://www.gazeta.uz/ru/2017/11/21/football/ |publisher= Gazeta.uz |language= ru |title= Высшая и Первая лиги Узбекистана сменят названия |date=2017-11-21 }} The draw for the 2018 Super League season was held on 3 February 2018. The first matchday is scheduled for 1 March 2018.{{cite news |url= https://championat.asia/ru/news/kogda-nachnetsya-superliga-2018|publisher= Championat.asia|language= ru |title= Когда начнется Суперлига-2018? |date=2018-02-03}} [[Sementchi]], the winner of 2017 [[Uzbekistan First League]] did not participate in new Super League season. The club failed to pass licensing procedures like [[Mash'al Mubarek]].{{cite news |url= https://www.uzdaily.uz/articles-id-35909.htm |publisher= Uzdaily.uz |language= ru |title= ФФУ объявила список команд, которые примут участие в Суперлиге |date=2018-01-25 }} These both clubs have been replaced by [[Neftchi Fergana]] and [[Sogdiana Jizzakh]] which according to 2017 season have been relegated to First League. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: left;" |- !
